row.name: Steel Hand
row.effect: Requires Teräs Käsi. Single unarmed attack at -1 to skill. The target may not use Danger Sense, nor any Force power granting a defensive bonus, against this attack.

levels.name: Steel Hand
levels.effect: Requires Teräs Käsi. Single unarmed attack at -1 to skill. The target may not use Danger Sense, nor any Force power granting a defensive bonus, against this attack.

levels.name: Steel Hand
levels.effect: As Tier 1 at no penalty to skill. A Force Sensitive target defends at an additional -1.

levels.name: Steel Hand
levels.effect: As Tier 2 at +1 to skill, and the additional penalty is -2. On a hit, a Force Sensitive target must make a Will roll or be unable to spend Force Points on their next turn.

levels.name: Steel Hand
levels.effect: As Tier 3 at +2 to skill, and the additional penalty is -3. The Will roll is at -2, and on a critical hit the target immediately loses 1d Force Points.
